command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
test "$(hostname)" = "ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein"
EXPECTED_OLD="0ab232f7112b046ced7e3e4ae454fe0d800eebd32d23bdac138c961bc069dff9"
CUR="$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "PRE_SHA=$CUR"
test "$CUR" = "$EXPECTED_OLD"
BACKUP="buehne_daemon.py.go-gpu-v3-backup-20260912T0714"
cp -a buehne_daemon.py "$BACKUP"
test "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_OLD"
rollback(){ echo 'ROLLBACK'; cp -a "$BACKUP" buehne_daemon.py; python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py; systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service || true; }
trap 'rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then rollback; fi; exit $rc' EXIT
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('buehne_daemon.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''             "--disable-gpu",
             "--disable-gpu-compositing",
             "--disable-software-rasterizer"],'''
new='''],'''
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'exact GPU flag block count={s.count(old)} expected=1')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
for token in ('--disable-gpu','--disable-gpu-compositing','--disable-software-rasterizer'):
    if token in s:
        raise SystemExit(f'GPU-disable token remains in daemon source: {token}')
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
PY
python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py
NEW_SHA="$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "NEW_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service
sleep 12
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = "active"
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/ >/dev/null
MAIN="$(pgrep -af '^/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127\.0\.0\.1:8788/' || true)"
echo '=== LIVE MAIN CHROME ==='
printf '%s\n' "$MAIN"
test -n "$MAIN"
if printf '%s\n' "$MAIN" | grep -Eq -- '--disable-gpu([ =]|$)|--disable-gpu-compositing([ =]|$)|--disable-software-rasterizer([ =]|$)'; then
  echo 'FAIL: live main Chrome still carries GPU-disable flags' >&2
  exit 41
fi
GPU="$(pgrep -af '^/opt/google/chrome/chrome --type=gpu-process' || true)"
echo '=== LIVE GPU PROCESS ==='
printf '%s\n' "$GPU"
test -n "$GPU"
if printf '%s\n' "$GPU" | grep -q -- '--use-gl=disabled'; then
  echo 'FAIL: live GPU process reports --use-gl=disabled' >&2
  exit 42
fi
RENDERERS="$(pgrep -af '^/opt/google/chrome/chrome --type=renderer' || true)"
echo '=== LIVE RENDERERS ==='
printf '%s\n' "$RENDERERS" | head -12
if printf '%s\n' "$RENDERERS" | grep -q -- '--disable-gpu-compositing'; then
  echo 'FAIL: live renderer still disables GPU compositing' >&2
  exit 43
fi
echo '=== RESOURCE SNAPSHOT ==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,pcpu,pmem,rss,args --sort=-pcpu | awk '$0 ~ /chrome-profile/ && $0 !~ /awk/ {print}' | head -12 || true
echo '=== FINAL SOURCE ==='
sha256sum buehne_daemon.py buehne.html filmlook.js
echo 'GPU_LIVE_V3_PASS'
trap - EXIT
